fabrics.name: Satin
fabrics.description: A smooth, light-catching surface for clean lines and fluid folds. Satin describes a fabric construction, not a promise of silk content.
fabrics.drape: Fluid to structured, depending on weight
fabrics.imageCaption: Satin dress with a cascading ruffle.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Stretch Satin
fabrics.description: The sheen of satin with stretch in the fabric. Check the individual dress for stretch level, support and fit.
fabrics.drape: Follows the silhouette; varies by construction
fabrics.notes: Ask us about the fabric and finish of your chosen dress before ordering.
fabrics.sourceConflict: Available product titles name this fabric, but the corresponding dress.fabric values are Satin or empty. No image assigned.

fabrics.name: Chiffon
fabrics.description: A light, sheer fabric often used in floating layers and soft ruffles. Lining and the number of layers determine coverage.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Tulle
fabrics.description: A fine net used for layered volume, overlays and airy skirts. Different weights and layers create different levels of fullness.
fabrics.imageCaption: Tulle skirt with a separate lace bodice.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Mesh
fabrics.description: An open-net fabric used for sheer panels, overlays and embellished surfaces. Mesh does not by itself tell you how much a dress stretches.
fabrics.drape: Varies with net structure and layers
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Lace
fabrics.description: A patterned, openwork fabric that brings detail to a bodice, sleeve or overlay. Motif, lining and placement vary by dress.
fabrics.imageCaption: Lace corset bodice; the skirt is a different material.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Organza
fabrics.description: A sheer fabric with more body than a softly flowing layer. Often used for defined folds and lightweight volume.
fabrics.imageCaption: Organza skirt with a separate satin bodice.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Taffeta
fabrics.description: A close-woven fabric known for its crisp hand and shaped folds. Its structured character can give skirts a defined silhouette.
fabrics.notes: Ask us about the fabric and finish of your chosen dress before ordering.
fabrics.sourceConflict: Available product titles name this fabric, but the corresponding dress.fabric values are Satin or empty. No image assigned.

fabrics.name: Crepe
fabrics.description: A fabric with a subtly textured surface, often chosen for a quieter finish and clean lines. Weight and drape vary by construction.
fabrics.imageCaption: Crepe skirt with a separate lace bodice.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Stretch Crepe
fabrics.description: Crepe texture with stretch in the fabric. The degree of stretch and the finished fit depend on the particular dress.
fabrics.imageCaption: Stretch crepe dress showing the back and train.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Knit
fabrics.description: A loop-constructed fabric used for a range of surfaces and silhouettes. Knit describes construction; fiber content and stretch still vary.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.

fabrics.name: Velvet
fabrics.description: A short-pile fabric whose tone changes as the surface catches the light. Compare images from more than one angle when choosing a shade.
fabrics.imageCaption: Velvet bodice with a separate satin skirt.
fabrics.notes: Fabric characteristics are general guidance. Refer to the selected dress for composition, lining, stretch and care.
